I added a 0.25s sleep after each request in `tests/test_payments.py`. At 4 requests a second, that stays under the sandbox's 5/s limit. I haven't run the test, since it calls the real sandbox.

The delay is a `CALL_DELAY_S` constant at the top of the file, so you can change it in one place.

I also saved the rate-limit fact to EngramDB so later sessions know about it.
